title: time_entry
description: A time entry exactly as the REST API returns it (OpenSpec time-tracking).

endedAt.description: Unix milliseconds; null while the entry runs

minutes.description: whole minutes, a running entry up to the server time

note.description: user-written; ciphertext for an encrypted account

focus.description: what a Focus work session wrote on the entry, null for any other entry (OpenSpec focus-session-readable)

mode.description: pomodoro, flowtime or countdown; a newer client may write another value

session.description: the work session's number in the Pomodoro cycle, 0 for the other modes

plannedEndAt.description: Unix milliseconds when the stretch ends if nothing changes; null for Flowtime
